headings.usage: Authoritative, squarish headers for strategy names, module titles.

data_and_code.usage: CRITICAL: All numbers, prices, volumes, P&L, timestamps, and ticker symbols must use this font to ensure tabular alignment.

background.description: Deep obsidian / 10% grey for the application base.

surface.description: Cardless UI panels, sidebars, modal backgrounds.

border.description: Exposed grid lines, 1px solid panel separators.

layout_and_spacing.padding: Dense mode: p-2 for data rows, p-4 for panel headers
layout_and_spacing.borders: Exposed skeleton. Use border-r border-b border-[#222222] heavily to separate data points instead of cards.

components.buttons: Flat surface, 1px border. Hover: invert colors or slight lightness bump. Never rounded.
components.tables: Tabular lining, sticky headers, monospaced numbers, subtle alternating row colors.
components.charts: Recharts/Shadcn charts, but MUST use the neon accent colors (Acid Green/Signal Red) on dark backgrounds.
components.inputs: Shadcn inputs customized to square edges, high contrast focus rings (ring-white/50).
components.modals: Backdrop blur is OK (glassmorphism), but surface must be stark #121212 with 1px border.

motion.data_updates: Subtle background flash (green/red) when a price or P&L ticks up or down. No layout shifts.

hero_background.description: Abstract neon chart lines for the Login/Register screen background.
hero_background.usage: Use with an overlay (bg-black/80) to maintain text legibility.

texture_pattern.usage: Can be used as a subtle background texture (opacity 5-10%) in empty states or side panels.

icons.style: Technical, sharp, consistent stroke width. Use 'regular' or 'bold' weights, avoid 'duotone' in dense tables.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure white text on primary/accent buttons. Use APCA contrast checks for data grids.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-form-submit-button', data-testid='nifty-price-ticker').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Install fonts: Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, and JetBrains Mono via Google Fonts in index.html or global css.
3. Override tailwind.config.js and index.css heavily. Map the variables above to the Shadcn UI CSS variables. Specifically set `--radius: 0px` or `2px`.
4. Do NOT use generic rounded cards with shadows. Use flat, adjacent panels separated by 1px borders.
5. For the Live Dashboard: Make it look like a Bloomberg Terminal / Pro Trading View. Dense, monospaced numbers, stark high-contrast text.
6. Whenever displaying P&L or live prices, flash a subtle background color on update.
7. Include `data-testid` on all buttons, form inputs, navigation links, and specific data rows (e.g., 'pnl-value', 'strategy-toggle-ema').
8. Mock the trading platform APIs (Zerodha/Breeze) visually and technically as requested.
